22 Nations Cut Oil Production, Impact on India Prices Unclear

Twenty-two countries, including OPEC+ members and allies, have agreed to cut oil production. This decision comes after a period of reduced oil and gas vessel movement through the Strait of Hormuz. The cuts aim to stabilize oil prices, with some reports suggesting crude oil prices have fallen below $70 per barrel. The specific impact of these production cuts on petrol and diesel prices in India remains uncertain, with some outlets posing it as a question.
